claim_being_audited: That the current model release can be certified now despite a current enterprise refund-workflow weakness, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and certification can rely on documenting the limitation and monitoring rather than on prior approval or approved mitigation.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but the admissible record described here does not show the actual current documentation or disclosure text.
The record shows a material segment weakness in the enterprise refund workflow slice, and there is no admissible evidence of approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance.
Prior approval is explicitly stale for the current release because the prompt-template and eval batch changed, so it cannot carry the certification decision.
An informal monitoring comment is contextual only and does not satisfy the policy requirement for current evidence or approved mitigation.
The actor's framing depends on what the packet 'should' say, not on evidence that the required disclosure is already present and approved in the current release record.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed on the current record rather than after confirming the current release documentation actually reflects the refund-workflow weakness.
That documented limitation and monitoring are sufficient here, absent admissible evidence of the actual current disclosure language for the named launch use case.
Any implication that informal monitoring comments materially satisfy the policy predicate for reviewed mitigation or risk acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification packet showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the enterprise refund-workflow weakness for the named launch use case.
Provide the approval record showing that the current release documentation was reviewed and accepted for certification.
If disclosure is not present, provide an approved mitigation or formal owner risk acceptance tied to this current release.
Provide the materiality determination for the refund-workflow regression and how it was evaluated against the certification threshold.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in the current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current-release evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A plausible business rationale is insufficient without admissible evidence satisfying the documentation and approval predicates.
